reviews.title: Unloads Too Often
reviews.text: i’ve been using this app for years and i have always had it on my ipad for easy access just in case i want to type out a journal or an essay rather than write it down but i find it stalling, glitchy, or will promptly try to update itself without ever finishing too often and i find it so risky to use it for any of real importance in case i lose it

reviews.title: Sync won't work; entries not safe!!!
reviews.text:
Warning to anyone who expects this app to continually sync and keep your information safe...
This app stopped syncing back in January, 10 months ago. The only solution the app team has for me is to either pay for a subscription, or export all of my previous entries and then restart the app. Which will then most likely not have any of my entries. To clarify, it is saying that I am logged into two devices at one time. I am not. Nor have I ever been. It just doesn't work correctly. (unless you pay; allegedly)

reviews.title: I refuse to pay to have access on both my iOS purchase and macOS. Sorry
reviews.text:
I refuse to pay to have access on both my iOS purchase and macOS. Sorry My data is in the cloud. Too bad you require more cash to access it on macOS natively.
Also, “some” additional support for v 27 devices is so slow in coming, why should I pay for the sluggish adoptatation that you have had many months to implement and yet have not?
Also, stealing my intimate data is so lame that you should be ashamed of your privacy practices.

reviews.title: Terrific!
reviews.text:
UPDATE - AMAZING PRODUCT FROM AN AWFUL COMPANY!


Wow! This is hands-down the best journal app out there!  I use it every single day and I think the changes are great!

After purchasing several different journal apps I got the original day one as a free app of the week and it just won me over, and with this new version they really refined an already great experience.

reviews.title: Love this App
reviews.text:
I've been using this app for years and it is immensely helpful, particularly since it's searchable. Brilliant for tracking moods, medical issues and the like. 
I wish the editing functions were better. It's difficult to place the cursor if you want to go back and change something.

reviews.title: Bad taste
reviews.text: I remember paying for this app many years ago, thought I would redownload to start journaling again. Turns out they’ve released another version and then transitioned that to freemium and my original payment doesn’t mean anything anymore? Not a huge deal but leaves a bad taste in my mouth and probably will pay for a different journaling app instead

reviews.title: AI in a journaling app?
reviews.text: I noticed the little star thing that indicates an AI feature. AI. In a journaling app. It’s like, tell me you don’t fundamentally understand the point of journaling without telling me.

reviews.title: Typical Greed
reviews.text: As usual, greed from developers ALWAYS ruins a good thing. I’m exporting all my diaries and deleting the app.

reviews.title: bah
reviews.text: Ai is pushy pushy.. I am done

reviews.title: But whyyyy?
reviews.text: So I haven’t journaled in a really long time and decided I would open up this app to start back only to be met with a screen asking for $50 or a yearly subscription. I had a free subscription and I am no longer able to access my earlier entries because I cannot get around the screen asking me for money. Is there a workaround?

reviews.title: Missing 2 months of Journal Entry - No help from app support team
reviews.text: If you have this app I recommend you quickly export your journal so you would not be in the same position. I had the misfortune of losing 2 whole months of daily journal entry. All of the recommended troubleshooting amounted to diddly squats. After going back and forth with the support team and happiness engineer I am still awaiting resolution. I STRONGLY RECOMMEND YOU EXPORT YOUR ENTRIES ASAP ESPECIALLY IF YOU HAVE THE FREE VERSION. Hoping Dayone resolves the issue and “recover” the missing entries without forcing me to pay $50. Still waiting patiently

reviews.title: Last update
reviews.text:
2022: A lot of basic text editing features are missing.  No text colors, single color for highlighting.

It is been a while, but still no fix.

2024: Last update is not an improvement of the look. Huge font, can only see few entries. Please, add an option to get back to an old look.

12/7/2025: After last update, copy/cut/paste functionality is messed up.  Cannot select more than 10 lines of text.  Practically unusable.

7/28/26 - copy/cut/paste functionality is still not fixed. You can’t copy even a few paragraphs, page starts jumping, text becomes unselected. The only work around is to go by small chunks of text.  Very annoying that it is still not fixed.
For some reason they never fix reported issues.

reviews.title: Disappointed with Day One’s AI Feature Changes
reviews.text:
I used to love Day One, but I’m really disappointed with how they handled the AI features.

When I upgraded, AI was advertised as one of the premium features. Now, those same AI features have been moved behind an even more expensive subscription tier. Existing paying customers weren’t clearly informed that something they already paid for would require another upgrade.

I’m not against companies charging for new features, but taking away or restricting features that were part of the premium experience feels misleading. A little transparency and better communication would have gone a long way.

Day One is still a beautiful journaling app, but this change has made me lose trust in the company. I hope they reconsider how they treat their loyal subscribers.

reviews.title: Missing Critical Search Within Note Feature
reviews.text:
I wish I had learned before committing to this app that it has deliberately, despite consistent user requests, refused to add in a very critical search-within-note feature. 

This is really sad because it is a solid journaling app. even the free version. I've enjoyed using it quite a bit, but will probably need to leave it because if I can't search within my notes, then why type all of this information into it to begin with?

reviews.title: The best journal app for iOS just got a lot worse.
reviews.text:
New UI in the recent update completely loses the focus of being a journal app - too much wasted space and much harder to quickly switch between journals.

The new update also adds AI-based chats and journaling, which is fine if that’s how you want to write, but it feels like a big step in the wrong direction for this app.

reviews.title: Too expensive
reviews.text: $75 for a digital journal??? And….deleted.

reviews.title: HELP
reviews.text: I been using this app for about four years now. Love it BUT suddenly yesterday it disappeared and when I back to app search and tried to open it. It wouldn’t let me. I have it on my older iPad and it still works fine. Why can’t I get it back on my new iPad? I’ve been using it on it for a number of years already on this iPad.

reviews.title: Deleted my information
reviews.text: The app deleted years of journaling with an update.  I’m  beyond furious that I’ve lost my written thoughts and memories upon the birth of my daughter

reviews.title: Not Worth the Money
reviews.text: Why bother paying an annual fee for something that Apple provides for free?  I’ve used both this and Apple’s free version and I don’t see what I’m paying for.  I just wish I could get some of my money back.

reviews.title: Loved this app till it glitched
reviews.text: Hey maybe it’s just my phone but everytime I drop a pin in the maps it usually adds the location coordinates but it keeps saving as 0 0 coordinates and not the right location. Please fix! And I’d give it 5 stars but I’ve been using this app for a while and it’s worked amazing until this glitch started happening

reviews.title: Very Dissapointed
reviews.text:
The last update, despite the Day one Team claiming that nothing has been removed, have removed the step count feature!
This is one of the most important parts of the app. The team say they may consider reintegration of this feature at a later date, but you can bet we will all pay for that. 
I have Gold membership and if a stealthy reduction in features is a thing they think is acceptable to clients I shall find another and cheaper method to run my journal.

reviews.title: Dayone - what have you done?
reviews.text: My beloved DayOne has broken my heart. The one sanctuary I have each day is now infiltrated with AI. Why? What possible need was there? If people want prompts or to discuss their problems - they can use Claude or ChatGPT. I’ve now lost total trust in the company… who knows how my data is going to be used in the future. After so many years, I won’t be renewing… time to move on to pen and paper I think!

reviews.title: Broken!
reviews.text: I have used this app for over ten years but recently I’ve found it to be almost unusable. It is very slow to respond to my typing and often crashes mid diary entry so I lose everything I have written. I have updated to the latest version and the issues persist. I’m very disappointed and may look into alternative journal apps if this isn’t fixed.

reviews.title: Photo upload not working
reviews.text: I’ve been using the free version of this app and uploading a single photo to diary entries since 2021 - the app is now not allowing me to do this and prompting me to buy a subscription? App is perfect otherwise

reviews.title: New update slow!
reviews.text:
The latest update has slowed the app down to the point it’s virtually unusable! The app lags behind the typing
In the screen considerably. Please sort it out! Been using this app for about 11 years!

reviews.title: Unusable
reviews.text: App is slow to the point of being unusable. It cannot keep up with typing, and causes the entire phone to lag until it’s closed. Just utterly ruined. I’m VERY frustrated at losing years of journaling that I can no longer access.

reviews.title: FIX THE BUGS!
reviews.text: This app is great for nostalgia fans, type something, then wait 30 seconds for your words to appear on screen. Very 90’s

reviews.title: Poor performance
reviews.text: Used this app years ago with great success on my phone. Now I’ve got an iPad, and is amongst the recommended apps, thought I’d rekindle journaling again. However, the performance is DIABOLICAL! App hangs all the time making it impossible to do anything. Such a shame, used to be great.

reviews.title: Book printing
reviews.text: Have been trying to get journal printed but it’s a nightmare. Have ordered in the past with no problem. Help centre isn’t that helpful. Had this app for years but doubt I will renew. Anyone recommend another app?

reviews.title: Photos fill the printed journal
reviews.text: This app is great - but only you want a digital record. If you ever want to print your journal, the least relevant pictures can get turned into full page prints and the pics you want to be large are too small. There is no way to edit or set the photo sizes. For that reason, I am exploring other diary / journal apps.

reviews.title: Just stopped and did not update on the new software update
reviews.text: Did not update with the new software update. Cannot open the journal

reviews.title: No Family Sharing
reviews.text: This would cost $250 a year for my family, too much

reviews.title: No More Markdown Support….
reviews.text:
It seems that Markdown support in the app, is now completely removed, I’m instead, directed to use the web version. It isn’t even that i can’t paste in markdown ( which I used to previously, and it would be rendered mostly correctly ), I’m prevented from editing the entire entry! I appreciate that the use of markdown isn’t popular, but this used to work. 

If I wanted to use a web app, I would, but no, I want to use a native app. If DayOne keeps removing functionality, I’ll look elsewhere.

reviews.title: How difficult can it be to write an app for a diary that doesn’t want to charge you £50 a year?
No longer viable to use
reviews.text:
I was enjoying the app - but it kept deleting my recording - it just disappeared. 

I now voice record my daily journal straight onto an instagram post and add my photos. I do not wish to renew.
